% Original fixed-tier evaluation fixture for Set P (not a real paper).
% Custom operator macros and theorem environment declarations for eval-07-multifile.
\newcommand{\opnorm}[1]{\|#1\|_{\mathrm{op}}}
\newcommand{\dom}{\operatorname{Dom}}
\newcommand{\res}[2]{(#1 - #2)^{-1}}

\newtheorem{mythm}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{mylem}[mythm]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{myprop}[mythm]{Proposition}
\newtheorem{mycor}[mythm]{Corollary}
\theoremstyle{definition}
\newtheorem{mydef}[mythm]{Definition}
\newtheorem{myassump}{Assumption}
